verses.1: And kings were not appointed except by my will, and the poor were not enriched except by my command, and the mighty did not prevail except by my will.
verses.2: And I gave favor and wisdom to David, and to Solomon; and I added years to Hezekiah.
verses.3: And I shortened the days of Goliath, and I gave strength to Samson, and again I took away his strength.
verses.4: And I saved my servant David from the hand of Goliath the Philistine.
verses.5: And also from the hand of King Saul, and also from the hand of every other enemy who rose against him, and from the hand of all who opposed him and fought against him, because he kept my commandment.
verses.6: And I loved him, and all who keep my commandment, kings and princes, I love them and give them strength and victory over their enemies, because they have pleased me.
verses.7: And again I will give them a land of inheritance which I swore to their fathers, a pure and bright land, that they may inherit the land of their fathers.
